process.subtitle: We handle the entire production process — you just focus on your business. Total estimated time ±14 working days from consultation to ready-to-use labels.

steps.title: Consultation & Registration
steps.desc: The client contacts our team for a needs consultation. After an agreement, the client registers and completes brand data for the next process.

steps.title: Design & Personalization
steps.desc: Our design team creates label mockups according to the client's brand identity. Every detail from pattern, color, to size is tailored to product needs.

steps.title: Code & Label Production
steps.desc: The AG system generates unique codes with a 3-layer algorithm, then produces them into hologram/tafeta labels with multi-layer technology and tamper-evident features.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.desc: Our QC team performs thorough checks on print quality, QR code function, and hologram integrity. Labels that fail QC are destroyed with standard procedures.

steps.title: Batching & Packing
steps.desc: Labels that pass QC are systematically packed into batches and boxes with complete documentation, including batch numbers and certificates of authenticity.

steps.title: Delivery to Client
steps.desc: Label batches are shipped directly to the client's location with safe packaging. Clients receive ready-to-use products along with implementation guides and access to the monitoring dashboard.

faq.subtitle: Answers to frequently asked questions about our services.

items.q: What marking services does AuthenticGuards offer?
items.a: We currently provide 2 active marking services: (1) Hologram with QR — a flagship solution with dual security layers for premium products, and (2) Tafeta Label with QR — textile labels for the fashion & apparel industry. NFC Sticker and Printing QR on packaging solutions are still in the research & development stage.

items.q: How does Hologram with QR work?
items.a: Each premium hologram label comes with a unique QR code connected to a real-time database. Consumers scan the QR via smartphone to verify product authenticity in seconds. The label also has a tamper-evident feature — the code becomes invalid after the label is removed. Each AG code has a verification limit of up to 15 times.

items.q: Is the Tafeta Label resistant to washing?
items.a: Yes, our Tafeta Labels are designed to withstand 50+ washes without quality degradation. Premium material and high-resolution printing technology ensure the QR code remains clearly readable. The label design is fully customizable to your fashion product's brand identity.

items.q: Are NFC or packaging QR printing solutions available?
items.a: NFC Stickers and direct QR printing on packaging are currently not available to the public — still in the internal planning and research stage. For current marking needs, we recommend Hologram with QR or Tafeta Label with QR. Contact our team for a consultation on the best solution.
